newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINE INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT SEEN UP 8.0 PCT IN '97.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINE INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT SEEN UP 8.0 PCT IN '97.

text.p: Argentine Industry Secretary Alieto Guadagni revised upward to 8.0 percent Tuesday the estimate for industrial output growth this year.
The May forecast predicted output would rise between 6.5 and 7.0 percent this year.
Guadagni said eight percent growth would leave the levels of production six percent higher than in 1994, the previous record year.
Industrial production was up 7.9 percent in the first half of this year from the similar 1996 period.
